title: UPTET 2026 Syllabus
organization: Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test Authority
vacancyDetails: Exam syllabus and pattern for Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET) 2026
documentsRequired: Download official syllabus PDF from portal
howToApply:
1. Visit https://updeled.gov.in
2. Open Syllabus / Notification PDF
3. Download UPTET 2026 Syllabus
4. Note exam pattern and marking scheme
5. Prepare topic-wise as per official units
shortDescription: UPTET 2026 Syllabus – Paper 1 and Paper 2 complete section-wise topics.
content:
UPTET 2026 syllabus follows the standard teacher eligibility pattern for Primary and Upper Primary levels.

Paper 1 (Classes I–V)

  • Child Development & Pedagogy
  • Language I (Hindi)
  • Language II (English/Urdu/Sanskrit)
  • Mathematics
  • Environmental Studies

Paper 2 (Classes VI–VIII)

  • Child Development & Pedagogy
  • Language I & II
  • Mathematics & Science or Social Studies

Confirm marks distribution from the official UPTET notification.
